description:
Cast Wavesifter for its evoke cost by paying {G}{U}.
Wavesifter enters the battlefield and is immediately sacrificed, triggering Wavesifter and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Wavesifter trigger, creating two Clue, two Food, and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Wavesifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{U}.
Repeat.
